basics.name: Shubham Prasad
basics.label: Development Economics Aspirant with Gym, Tech, Reading and Music Hobbies
basics.summary: Economics Aspirant with a Post Graduate Diploma in Statistical Methods and Analytics from Indian Statistical Institute. Interned at Paytm, GXCO and NITI Aayog, developing data pipelines, ERP solutions, and validating government datasets. Passionate about solving real-world problems in finance, NGO operations, and government policy to uplift human lives.

work.name: Paytm
work.summary: Contributed to a fraud detection portal for Gulf telecom providers and assisted the ML team with dataset analysis and scoring.
highlights: Assisted the machine learning team in analysing telecom provider datasets and building a confidence-based ranking system to evaluate and compare different companies, plans, and value metrics.
Contributed to an internal fraud detection portal being developed in collaboration with Gulf telecom providers, supporting data review and pipeline work.

work.name: GXCO
work.summary: Built ERP portals, data pipelines, and lead-tracking dashboards for multiple NGO clients using Frappe, Google BigQuery, and custom integrations.
highlights: Built Frappe-based ERP portals for NGO clients, customising modules to fit their specific operational workflows around schools, events, and internal processes.
Integrated WhatsApp-based order and event data for an NGO client via API into Google BigQuery, and built a clean dashboard to track conversions and interactions.
Worked with an NGO's fundraising team to build a lead tracking dashboard — coordinated with their leads platform, and set up filters to manage lead status (new, contacted, converted, etc.).
Assisted with an accounting classification task, helping organise and categorise data across states, districts, and schools for a client's reporting needs.

work.name: NITI Aayog
work.summary: Validated and organised datasets for the NDAP portal and facilitated sessions for the Women Entrepreneurship Platform.
highlights: Validated and organised datasets from the NDAP portal (covering 31 sectors and 53 ministries), cross-referencing against original government sources to ensure accuracy.
Facilitated Women Entrepreneurship Platform (WEP) sessions — moderated meetings, managed the discussion flow between entrepreneurs and mentors, and ensured sessions ran smoothly.

work.name: Glued Entertainment
work.summary: Handled digital marketing, social media outreach, content creation, and vendor coordination for an arcade and events brand.
highlights: Managed SEO efforts and Instagram outreach to grow the brand's online presence and drive footfall.
Designed promotional banners and reels for social media campaigns and event announcements.
Contacted and coordinated with vendors, and participated in deal discussions and negotiations for events.

projects.name: githubfetch
projects.description: Python CLI tool to view GitHub profiles in the terminal, published on PyPI
highlights: Install with `pip install githubfetch`, then run `githubfetch <username>` to view a stylised GitHub profile in your terminal.
Pulls data from GitHub's GraphQL and REST APIs to display user info, pinned repos, and a contribution heatmap.
Inspired by neofetch — built for developers who live in the terminal.

projects.name: Home Server
projects.description: Self-hosted homelab running on an Optiplex 3060 with media, storage, and network services
highlights: Running Jellyfin, *arr stack (Sonarr, Radarr, etc.), Nextcloud, and Immich for media management and personal cloud storage.
Set up Pi-hole for network-wide ad blocking, with Cloudflare and Nginx as reverse proxy for external access.
Manages DNS, SSL, and routing for all services — accessible remotely with proper auth and tunnelling.

projects.name: DataViz — Data Visualisation Tool
projects.description: Chat with your dataset and get charts back, built on a microservices architecture
highlights: Upload a CSV/database, ask questions in plain English — GPT-4/Gemini generates SQL, runs it, and returns interactive charts.
4 services: Next.js frontend, LangGraph Python backend, Node.js SQLite server, Flask API — all containerised with Docker.
Supports 5 chart types with streaming WebSocket responses.

projects.name: Yoga Pose Classifier
projects.description: Classifies 107 yoga poses from a live webcam feed
highlights: Uses MediaPipe to extract body landmarks in real time, fed into a PyTorch model trained on 5.6k images.
~75% accuracy across 107 poses, deployed as a Streamlit web app.

projects.name: Movie Recommendation Engine
projects.description: Hybrid recommender combining content-based filtering and popularity-based ranking
highlights: Covers 45,000+ movies using TF-IDF on metadata and collaborative filtering on user-movie interaction data.
Handles cold-start by falling back to popularity-based suggestions for new users.

projects.name: Expense Tracker
projects.description: Personal finance dashboard built with Streamlit and SQLite
highlights: Track income and expenses across custom categories with full CRUD support.
Visualises spending patterns over time using Matplotlib and Seaborn.
